description.short: A professional 2D drawing tool designed for reliable drafting and detailing. It is a full offline installer and standalone setup.

long.overview: AutoCAD LT 2019 is a very handy and professional 2D drawing tool that has been developed specifically for those who need a very powerful as well as reliable drafting and detailing application. It has a user interface which may seem overwhelming but is designed for professionals. This 2D drafting tool requires a powerful computer running the latest Windows operating systems. You can create projects right from scratch by adding lines, arcs, circles, polylines, shapes, and various other types of objects. Existing CAD projects can be enhanced by inserting new objects, clipping, and adding hyperlinks. You can also change the layout and preview the changes in real time. Once the work on your design is done, you can export it to DWF, PDF, or DGN format and then share it with colleagues.
features: A handy and professional 2D drawing tool for powerful and reliable drafting and detailing.
A comprehensive user interface designed for professional use.
Requires a powerful computer running the latest Windows operating systems.
Create projects from scratch by adding lines, arcs, circles, polylines, shapes, and other objects.
Enhance existing CAD projects by inserting new objects, clipping, and using hyperlinks.
Export designs to DWF, PDF, or DGN formats for easy sharing.

minimum.processor: 3 GHz Intel Pentium processor or later
